title: Reasoning over Non-Parametric Memory in Multilingual LLMs: A Cognitive-Based Analysis of Relational Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2611.06715v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assumes that language models can reason over relations stated in their context rather than fall back on associations memorized during pretraining. We study this evidence-conditioned relational reasoning in isolation, with the facts supplied directly in the prompt rather than retrieved. \textsc{Rel-Bloom} is a controlled multilingual diagnostic of 450 multiple-choice questions built from 30 Wikidata relations; the same source relations are instantiated at five Bloom-inspired levels (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate) and under three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, Neutralized). Across 43 models, six languages, and two multilingual settings (226,800 predictions), three findings stand out. First, accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every evaluated open-weight model series, reaching 47.2 percentage points for the Large Granite bucket, but not for either Gemini mode

translated_title: 多语言大语言模型中基于非参数记忆的推理：关系知识的认知分析
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）假设语言模型能够对其上下文中陈述的关系进行推理，而不是退回到预训练期间记忆的关联上。我们单独研究了这种基于证据的关系推理，事实直接在提示中提供而非通过检索获取。Rel-Bloom是一个受控的多语言诊断工具，包含基于30个Wikidata关系构建的450道多项选择题；相同的源关系在五个基于布鲁姆认知分类法的层次（记忆、理解、应用、分析、评估）以及三种真实性条件（事实性、反事实、中性化）下进行实例化。在43个模型、6种语言和两种多语言设置（共计226,800个预测）的实验中，有三个发现尤为突出。首先，在每一个被评估的开源权重模型系列中，从“应用”到“分析”层次的准确率均急剧下降，大型Granite组的降幅达到47.2个百分点，但两个Gemini模式并非如此。
tldr: 该研究提出Rel-Bloom多语言认知诊断基准，在五个布鲁姆认知层次和三种真实性条件下对43个模型进行大规模测试，发现多语言大模型在基于上下文证据进行关系推理时，从“应用”到“分析”层次准确率急剧下降，揭示出模型对非参数记忆进行高阶推理的能力存在显著瓶颈。
en_tdlr: The study introduces Rel-Bloom, a controlled multilingual cognitive diagnostic built from Wikidata relations, and shows across 43 models and six languages that LLMs' ability to reason over in-context evidence rather than memorized associations drops sharply from the Apply to Analyze Bloom levels in open-weight models.
